title: A loan with a minimum rule and planned extra, a pay-later plan, and a card that carries a balance (decision H7)
story: One bank, set up Thu 26 Nov 2026 with 500,000, the day after pay. Pay of 300,000 on the 25th, moved earlier. A car loan of 1,000,000 is paid on the 5th (moved later): the minimum is 2% of what is owed, at least 10,000, and from 1 Jan 2027 an extra 5,000 is planned each time. A pay-later plan has 30,000 left, 10,000 a month on the 15th (moved later). A card that carries a balance closes on the 20th and is paid on the 10th of the next month (moved later): the minimum is 5% of the statement, at least 3,000, and an extra 2,000 is planned from 1 Dec. Its 100,000 statement of 20 Nov is not paid yet. All three are paid from the bank. Interest is not worked out in this test (see SCHEMA_V3 section 14). No holidays are listed. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 20,000 (car loan: 2% of 1,000,000) + 7,000 (card: 5% of 100,000 and the planned 2,000 extra) + 10,000 (pay-later part) = 37,000

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 500,000 (Bank today) - 20,000 (Car loan 7 Dec) - 7,000 (Card that carries 10 Dec) - 10,000 (Pay-later 15 Dec) = 463,000
asks.note: The 25 Dec pay of 300,000 comes before the January payments (24,600, 6,650 and 10,000), so the lowest point is 15 Dec.

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 5,000 (5% of the 100,000 statement, above the 3,000 floor) + 2,000 (planned extra from 1 Dec) = 7,000
asks.note: Before H7 the model asked for the whole 100,000.

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 5,150 (5% of the 103,000 statement: 100,000 carried - 7,000 paid + 10,000 spent) + 2,000 (planned extra) = 7,150

asks.question: due_before_next_pay
asks.why: 24,600 (car loan: 2% of 980,000 is 19,600, plus the 5,000 extra from 1 Jan) + 7,150 (card) + 10,000 (pay-later) = 41,750
